quirks.description: Svelte appends scoped hashes like 'svelte-7ma46z' to class names. These are not meaningful for migration.
quirks.workaround: Strip classes matching /svelte-[a-z0-9]+/ from section labels. Keep in structure.md for reference.

quirks.description: Svelte SPAs render fallback content when session state is missing. Stateful pages show a default view instead of expected page.
quirks.workaround: Use probe-page.ts to detect fallback. Use extract-spa-flow.ts with a flow definition for stateful pages.

quirks.description: SvelteKit uses client-side routing with data-sveltekit-preload-data and data-sveltekit-preload-code for prefetching.
quirks.workaround: For multi-step flows, navigate through the real user journey using extract-spa-flow.ts instead of hitting URLs directly.

quirks.description: Sites using Tailwind CSS produce zero svelte- scoped class elements, causing detection failure if relying solely on class-based detection. This is the dominant modern SvelteKit pattern.
quirks.workaround: Use __sveltekit_* global and data-sveltekit-preload-data attribute as primary detection signals instead of svelte- classes.

quirks.description: SvelteKit's default app.html wraps content in <div style='display: contents'>. Some sites customize to <div id='svelte'>.
quirks.workaround: Use both '#svelte > *' and 'body > div:first-of-type > *' in spaContainerHints.

quirks.description: SvelteKit sites with real-time features (analytics, SSE, websockets) never reach Playwright's networkidle state.
quirks.workaround: Use domcontentloaded + waitForTimeout instead of networkidle for SvelteKit sites.

localSite.sectionSelector: body > header, body > nav, main > *, body > footer
